methodology.value_formula: Selected BenchLM Coding or Agentic category divided by positive base token cost; exploratory only. No cross-metric fallback, normalization, or confidence multiplier.
methodology.caveat: Category coverage and harnesses differ. Pareto labels apply only within the selected set. Controlled research requires exact model snapshot, benchmark version, harness, budget, and source per observation. Model-level verified counts do not verify each raw cell.
